data.name: Hungarian Chickenpox Cases
data.abstract: A spatio-temporal dataset of weekly chickenpox cases from Hungary. The dataset consists of a county-level adjacency matrix and time series of the county-level reported cases between 2005 and 2015.

additional_info.summary: A spatio-temporal dataset of weekly chickenpox (childhood disease) cases from Hungary. The dataset consists of a county-level adjacency matrix and time series of the county-level reported cases between 2005 and 2015. There are 2 specific related tasks: County level case count prediction and nation level case count prediction.
additional_info.variable_info: Attributes are weekly counts of chickenpox cases in Hungarian counties.
